title: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of A Supplement on Symptoms of Menopause and Overall Well-being
official: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of A Supplement on Symptoms of Menopause and Overall Well-being
summary:
This study evaluates the effects of Primal Harvest's Primal Meno+ supplement on symptoms of menopause and overall well-being in females aged 40-60 who are currently menopausal and experiencing at least two menopausal symptoms. Over a 12-week period, 40 participants will take one capsule of the test product daily with their first meal of the day.

Participants will complete self-reported questionnaires at Baseline, Week 4, Week 8, and Week 12 to assess menopausal symptoms (including hot flashes, night sweats, sleep quality, stress resilience, and emotional well-being) and overall health and well-being. This is a single-arm, open-label, virtual trial with no randomization or blinding.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Be female.
* Be aged 40-60.
* Anyone who is currently menopausal and experiencing at least two of the following symptoms of menopause: hot flashes
* night sweats
* sleep disturbances (e.g., insomnia, trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or experiencing restless or disrupted sleep)
* mood changes (e.g., mood swings, irritability, increased anxiety, feelings of sadness or depression)
* fatigue and lack of energy.
* Anyone who is generally healthy - does not live with any uncontrolled chronic disease.
* If taking oral over-the-counter supplements or herbal remedies targeted at symptoms of menopause, has been consistently taking these for at least 3 months prior to starting the study, and is willing to maintain this routine for the study duration.
* Not planning on introducing any products or any new forms of prescription medication or supplements that target symptoms of menopause for the study duration.
* Resides in the United States.
* Willing to maintain the same diet and exercise regimen consistently throughout the study duration.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Anyone with pre-existing chronic conditions that would prevent participants from adhering to the protocol, including oncological and psychiatric disorders.
* Anyone with any allergies or sensitivities to any of the study product ingredients.
* Any women who are pregnant, breastfeeding, or trying to conceive (or who will be at any point during the study period).
* Anyone unwilling to follow the study protocol.
* Anyone who is currently taking or planning to take, during the study period, any hormone replacement therapy (HRT).
* Anyone with a history of uterine fibroids, endometriosis, polycystic ovarian syndrome, or abnormal pap smears.
* Anyone who is a heavy drinker (i.e., eight or more alcoholic drinks per week for women).
* Anyone with a history of substance abuse.
* Currently partaking in another research study or will be partaking in any other research study at any point during this study's duration.
